definitions.K_eff(q): H_q(C|U), conditional entropy of the source-battery causal quotient given context

theorem.derivation: I(C;Y|U) = H(C|U) - H(C|Y,U); H(C|Y,U) >= 0 gives the upper bound; non-negativity of conditional mutual information gives the lower bound
theorem.absence_of_return: C independent of Y given U  =>  R = 0
theorem.label_duplication_invariance: subdividing labels within one causal class, q(C|U) unchanged, leaves K_eff unchanged
theorem.decomposition: R_cap = kappa_R * R_dec, where kappa_R = H(C|U)/log2|C*| and R_dec = I(C;Y|U)/H(C|U); manuscript primary choice is R = R_dec

control_descriptions.K0: four uniform causal classes, perfect return -> R=1 (calibration)
control_descriptions.K1: four non-uniform causal classes, perfect return
control_descriptions.K2: independent return channel -> R=0 (absence of return)
control_descriptions.K3: erasure channel on the return side -> partial R in (0,1)
control_descriptions.K4: duplicated intervention labels, causal class unchanged -> K_eff unchanged
control_descriptions.K5: bijective recoding of labels/classes/outputs -> K_eff, R invariant
control_descriptions.K6: context U with different causal-class distributions -> K_eff tracks H(C|U) correctly
control_descriptions.K7: two substrates, different nominal dimensions, same causal quotient -> identical K_eff and R

scope: definition and finite audit only; no empirical transformer measurement (see 06-transformer-measurement/, out of scope here)
